regime_read: The strongest measured alignment is in semiconductors/AI infrastructure and federal technology spending, but signal quality varies: MU and MSFT combine five distinct channels, while IBM and BAH show narrower contract-led setups. PLTR has strong convergence but is already extended, and the unscored track record requires modest conviction.
regime_read_zh: 当前最强的多源信号集中在半导体、AI基础设施及联邦科技支出，但信号质量不一：MU与MSFT均有五个独立渠道共振，而IBM和BAH更偏向由政府合同驱动的窄幅逻辑。PLTR虽共振较强但已明显延伸，且历史判断尚未进入评分阶段，因此整体置信度应保持克制。

theses.thesis: MU has one of the cleanest non-extended alignments: accelerating government grants, strongly positive measured insider activity, a substantial patent cluster, and bullish demand sentiment coincide with the newly introduced Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [bill:HR10170]. The Ro Khanna affiliation adds a disclosed policy-network connection but is qualitative rather than proof of an informational edge [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU是未明显延伸标的中共振较清晰的一只：政府补助加速、显著为正的内部人活动、较大的专利集群和看多需求情绪同时出现，并与新提出的《2026年存储芯片竞争力评估法案》方向一致 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [bill:HR10170]。Ro Khanna的关联提供了已披露的政策网络联系，但它只是定性信息，并不证明存在信息优势 [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would tend to support semiconductor-equipment demand [patent_cluster] [congress_cluster]
Semiconductor equipment — domestic advanced-memory investment implies additional fabrication-tool demand [bill:HR10170]
theses.dissent: The grant amount is limited relative to MU's operating scale, while insider and social-sentiment measures may be backward-looking or crowded [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [stocktwits_bull].

falsifier.text: Government-grant acceleration reverses and measured insider activity turns net negative while memory-policy legislation fails to advance.

theses.thesis: MSFT combines measured application demand, developer momentum, a large patent cluster, and two disclosed strategic-network links, including its factual partnership with Sam Altman [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]. The Trump-linked buy signal is an additional independent channel [trump], although 60-day relative strength is already close to the desk's extension boundary, making entry discipline important.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT同时具备应用需求、开发者动能、较大的专利集群以及两条已披露的战略网络联系，其中包括与Sam Altman的事实性合作关系 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]。特朗普关联的买入信号构成另一独立渠道 [trump]，但其60日相对强度已接近本桌的延伸阈值，入场纪律尤为重要。
second_order: NVDA — continued cloud and AI application demand supports accelerator consumption [app_demand] [github_momentum]
Data-center power infrastructure — sustained AI workloads imply greater power and facility requirements [app_demand] [github_momentum]
theses.dissent: The signals may largely reflect an already well-recognized AI narrative, and relative performance leaves less margin before the name becomes extended [app_demand] [github_momentum].

falsifier.text: Application-demand and developer-momentum measures weaken together while the strategic AI partnership ceases to support product adoption.

theses.thesis: IBM presents a contrarian contract-led setup: a sharp measured acceleration in recent federal-contract activity aligns with the pack's largest patent count and meaningful open-source/model-download activity [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. Its substantial underperformance versus SPY means the entry is not extended, but the three-channel convergence and nearby earnings date warrant low conviction.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM呈现出逆向、合同驱动的机会：近期联邦合同活动大幅加速，同时与本证据包中最高的专利数量及有意义的开源/模型下载活动相呼应 [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。其相对SPY显著落后，因而并未延伸，但只有三个渠道共振且临近财报，故置信度维持较低。
second_order: Federal IT modernization — accelerating contract awards imply continued agency technology spending [gov_contract_accel]
Enterprise AI software — patent and developer activity suggest ongoing commercialization efforts [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]
theses.dissent: The extreme acceleration rate may come from a depressed comparison base, and severe relative underperformance may signal fundamental weakness rather than opportunity [gov_contract_accel].

falsifier.text: Federal-contract activity normalizes toward its prior baseline and developer activity declines after the next earnings report.

theses.thesis: PLTR has genuine five-channel alignment led by accelerating federal contracts, unanimous measured analyst and Stocktwits bullishness, retail attention, and disclosed political/fund links [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [retail_buzz] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, its 60-day relative strength exceeds the desk's extension threshold, so the evidence supports watching for a reset rather than chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR确有五渠道共振，核心包括联邦合同加速、分析师与Stocktwits一致偏多、散户关注，以及已披露的政治人物和基金关联 [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [retail_buzz] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。但其60日相对强度已超过本桌的延伸阈值，因此应等待回调重置，而非追高。
second_order: BAH — broader federal analytics and modernization spending can support adjacent contractors [gov_contract_accel]
Federal fraud-detection technology — proposed DOJ information-sharing and enforcement measures could expand analytics demand [bill:HRES1530]
theses.dissent: Unanimously bullish analyst and retail readings can indicate crowded positioning, making valuation or momentum compression especially damaging [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [retail_buzz].

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration drops below prior-period levels while bullish analyst revisions reverse.

theses.thesis: BAH offers a narrower but coherent federal-spending read: government-contract activity is accelerating, a special-situation signal is present, and the Trump-linked channel points in the same direction [gov_contract_accel] [special_situation] [trump]. Proposed federal fraud-enforcement and law-enforcement information-sharing measures provide a plausible demand catalyst for government technology and consulting work [bill:HRES1530], but the absence of additional operating-demand channels keeps conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: BAH提供了较窄但逻辑一致的联邦支出机会：政府合同活动正在加速，特殊情形信号出现，特朗普关联渠道也指向同一方向 [gov_contract_accel] [special_situation] [trump]。拟议中的联邦反欺诈执法及执法机构信息共享措施，可能为政府科技与咨询业务带来需求催化 [bill:HRES1530]；但由于缺少更多经营需求渠道，置信度保持较低。
second_order: PLTR — expanded federal enforcement and information sharing can increase demand for government data platforms [bill:HRES1530]
Federal cybersecurity and analytics — agency modernization would benefit contractors exposed to secure data integration [gov_contract_accel] [bill:HRES1530]
theses.dissent: Only three channels align, and the special-situation and Trump-linked signals provide little detail about durable operating improvement [special_situation] [trump].

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration turns negative and the proposed enforcement legislation fails to progress beyond House consideration.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
